source_epoch.intentional_transition: User-approved PR409 squash merge and branch reset to origin/main. HEAD identity changed while all reviewed source bytes and full tree remain equal to E.

fixed_findings.result: Captured inverse_duration_word is parsed and compared strictly as an output, excluded from arithmetic_inputs. A NaN output with eligible finite true inputs is MISMATCH, not input exclusion.

Finite overflow retains EXCLUDED_SOURCE_FLOAT_DOMAIN and overflow_intermediate instead of losing the result to an unstructured ValueError. The try scope is arithmetic only; malformed input parsing remains outside, and errors without recorded arithmetic exclusions are re-raised.

cap*h is now evaluated after coefficients and before RHS as native motor_params does. Modeled expression order agrees; operation_count remains a modeled expression count, not the entire native mass/constructor trace.

endpoint_source_review.result: The selected full generic velocity block is copied into multibody.velocities before multibody.integrate. Helper strictly compares the selected generic word with the captured before multibody word.

For fixed-root one-DOF AngX, Multibody::integrate passes the link velocity slice and MultibodyJoint::integrate advances coords[DIM+0] by v*dt. The helper performs one rounded multiply followed by one rounded add; it does not reconstruct q from final stabilized V.

Integration leaves the multibody velocity array unchanged. Helper compares before/after selected velocity, exact matching row identity, dictionary native handle {index,generation}, u32 handle words, non-bool bounded integer indices, one DOF, ForceBased AngX. Changed final V, mixed identity and wrong axis/model/DOF are rejected or retained as mismatches.

Both helpers retain normal-or-zero scope, tiny/subnormal/overflow exclusion, and literal output word mismatches. Finite f32 limit clamp remains distinct from generic impulse clamp. Selected nonfinite computed coordinate/after-velocity outputs are MISMATCH for eligible inputs.

limitations: This source/pure PASS is not a frozen preregistration, actual observer/producer qualification, whole event/schema/replay or source/compiler closure verifier. Only bounded files and synthetic opaque words were examined.

Caller must bind actual BeforePositionIntegration after generic-V copy and before coordinate advancement, actual AfterPositionIntegration immediately after advancement, actual native coords[3], multibody root/link, cache and slice identity, event schedule, fixed-root topology, scalar width and compiler/runtime mode. Matching row metadata cannot alone establish those facts.

Constructor helper still deliberately checks only ERP/RHS/CFM/bounds. It does not admit complete row shape, original motor cap/model binding, actual MotorParameters, initial impulse +0, inv_lhs, full J/W arrays, joint/root/DOF identity or full solver offsets. Self-consistent extra malformed row fields can still match narrow formulas; whole-cohort admission must reject them separately.
Endpoint helper checks only the declared scalar native block/coordinate and selected generic velocity word; unrelated generic blocks and full private state are not validated.

Malformed schema errors remain errors. An arithmetic error after a recorded float-domain exclusion returns EXCLUDED rather than PASS; whole-cohort retention must count and preserve every excluded/failed/missing record without resampling.
No full hidden-state/private-cache equivalence, RHS origin, per-contact causality, actual runtime MXCSR/FTZ/DAZ or universal native operation order is established.

No motor physical accuracy, convergence, candidate adoption, new engine defect, hardware/external validation, or maturity improvement follows. Existing numerical evidence and historical failed outcomes were not read or reinterpreted.
